```python
# filename: assign_format.py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
format_indicators = {'DVD', 'Blu-Ray', 'VHS'}

# Create a 'Format' column where Title equals a format indicator, else NaN
df['Format'] = np.where(df['Title'].isin(format_indicators), df['Title'], np.nan)

# Forward-fill the format so rows after a format marker inherit it
df['Format'] = df['Format'].ffill()

print('Unique formats after ffill:', df['Format'].dropna().unique())
print(df.iloc[5:12][['Title','Year','Format','Status']])
```
